candidates.change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 1 ether, allowing different calls to pass and thus altering pastBlockTime updates and potential transfers.
Change the time comparison from > to >= so calls in the same block timestamp can update pastBlockTime and potentially trigger transfers differently.
Change pastBlockTime update to use block.number instead of block.timestamp, altering the recorded state and subsequent behavior.
Remove the require that block.timestamp is greater than pastBlockTime, allowing repeated calls in same timestamp to update pastBlockTime and possibly change transfer timing.
Change the transfer condition to use modulus 10 instead of 15 so transfer occurs on different blocks.
Transfer only a portion (1 ether) instead of the entire contract balance, altering post-call contract balance and observable behavior.
